articles.highlight: 算法可以实现供需双向精准匹配，而智能硬件的持续加入，会把家庭服务的各个环节重新整合、重新标准化。

articles.failureAnalysis: 核心判断是产业仍处0到1萌芽期，未进入1到100的爆发阶段，规模化兑现依赖更多企业入局与环节标准化。同时“万亿市场”属于媒体对该赛道的空间描述，而非已验证的当期收入。

articles.title: Dostoyevsky, Just After His Death Sentence Was Repealed, on the Meaning of Life
articles.highlight: 做一个与人同在的人，并且无论身处何种境遇都永远保持为人，不消沉、不灰心——这就是生命的意义，就是它的任务。
articles.summary: 这篇文章出自《大西洋月刊》旗下的 The Marginalian，讲述陀思妥耶夫斯基在死刑判决被撤销、临刑前最后一刻获赦之后，对生命意义的思考。文中引用的核心句子把生命的意义定义为：无论处境如何，都要作为人活在人群之中，不消沉、不灰心。它值得一读，是因为这段话并非抽象哲理，而是从死亡边缘回来的人给出的具体生活准则，对今天承受压力的人仍有直接的分量。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：真正可操作的人生准则往往不是宏大的目标，而是在任何境遇下都守住“作为人”的底线——不消沉、不灰心，这既是意义也是任务。
articles.sourceExcerpt: "To be a human being among people and to remain one forever, no matter in what circumstances, not to grow despondent and not to lose heart — that’s what life is all about, that's its task."

en.highlight: To be a human being among people and to remain one forever, no matter in what circumstances, not to grow despondent and not to lose heart — that's what life is all about, that's its task.
en.summary: This piece from The Marginalian recounts Dostoyevsky's reflections on the meaning of life after his death sentence was repealed at the last moment before execution. The quoted line defines the meaning of life as remaining a human being among people under any circumstance, neither despondent nor disheartened. It is worth reading because this is not abstract philosophy but a concrete rule for living from a man who came back from the edge of death, and it still speaks directly to people under pressure today.

articles.title: Decoding Imagined Speech: A Strictly Subject-Independent Approach Using EEG
articles.selectionReason: Open full-text paper; topic brain_computer_interface; quality signal passed; application scenario is clear.

paperCard.problem: 闭锁综合征等重度运动障碍患者有意识但无法沟通。用脑电直接“读”出脑子里想说的话，是一种潜在出路；但这个领域之前报告的高准确率（85%–97%）多来自不清晰的评估方式，比如数据划分没写清是按切窗还是按试次、是否跨被试，导致模型看起来很强却不一定能用在别人身上。
paperCard.method: 作者用同一套公开脑电数据，比较两条处理管线，用同一个随机森林分类器来评判。评估方式很严格：按被试划分做 5 折交叉验证（训练用一部分人、测试用完全没见过的另一部分人），再把每个 1 秒窗口的预测用“试次级多数投票”合并成整段试次的结论，最后做配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验比较两条管线。
paperCard.difference: 以前的研究常常混用“被试内”评估或没交代数据怎么切分，准确率被高估。这篇刻意采用“被试独立”的协议，即测试集里的人训练时完全没出现过，更接近真实使用场景，因此数字低很多但更可信；同时它不靠更复杂的模型，只靠换特征表示和更严谨的评估来比较。
paperCard.innovation: 据作者所述，这是首次在严格被试独立约束下评估该公开数据集，提供了一个现实的对照基线；此外还做了前向频段选择，发现少数几个频段（尤其 alpha，以及 alpha+delta）就能承载大部分可区分信息，不必用全部五个频段。
paperCard.implementation: 流程大致是：先做共同预处理（每段保留中间 10 秒、切成 1 秒窗口、75% 重叠、按被试做 z-score 标准化）。管线一（Kumar 管线）做 5 点滑动平均，每个通道算标准差、均方根、求和、信号能量四个统计量，得到 56 维特征；管线二（频谱管线）先做 50 Hz 陷波和 0.5–60 Hz 带通滤波，再用周期图估计功率谱密度，把 delta/theta/alpha/beta/gamma 五个频段的绝对功率积分出来，得到 70 维特征，并做对数变换降偏。分类用 200 棵树的随机森林，配合分层分组交叉验证（StratifiedGroupKFold）保证同一被试不跨折。
paperCard.applications: 可应用于脑机接口的沟通辅助设备（帮助闭锁综合征患者表达）、脑电信号的跨被试通用解码模型设计，以及作为未来方法研究的可信评测基准；其“严格被试独立评估”的思路也可移植到其他生理信号研究。
technicalTerms: 脑电（EEG）：从头皮电极记录的大脑电活动，信号很弱、噪声大
想象语音解码：根据大脑活动推测人心里“默说”的词语或类别
被试独立评估：测试时的人从未参与过训练，用来衡量对陌生人的泛化能力
随机森林：由很多棵决策树投票表决的机器学习分类器，稳定但不算最先进
功率谱密度（PSD）：描述不同频率上信号能量多少的曲线
频段功率：把脑电按 delta/theta/alpha/beta/gamma 频段分别求总能量作为特征
多数投票：把一段试次里多个 1 秒窗口的预测结果投票，得出整段的最终判断
交叉验证：把数据分成若干折轮流做训练和测试，减少单次划分的偶然性
前向特征选择：从一个特征开始，逐步加入最有帮助的特征看效果是否提升
伪迹：眨眼、肌肉活动等非脑源信号造成的干扰

en.highlight: Under strictly subject-independent evaluation, the spectral pipeline significantly outperformed the statistical pipeline: 49.03 ± 4.18% versus 37.97 ± 3.79%.
en.summary: Using the public Kumar imagined-speech EEG dataset (23 subjects, 14 channels), the paper compares a time-domain statistical feature pipeline with a frequency-domain band-power pipeline under random-forest classification. Its main contribution is not a higher score but the first strictly subject-independent, transparent baseline, showing that spectral features generalize better while overall accuracy reaches only about 49% (roughly 33% chance for three classes), suggesting earlier 85–97% reports may stem from leaky evaluation.
en.failureAnalysis: The evaluation covers only coarse three-class classification, and 49% accuracy is still far from practical use, while minimal artifact removal and no channel selection make the results conservative and potentially noise-limited.
en.title: Decoding Imagined Speech with EEG: A Strictly Subject-Independent Approach

paperCard.problem: Patients with locked-in syndrome have intact cognition but almost no motor control, so communication is extremely difficult. Decoding imagined speech from EEG could offer a communication pathway, but previously reported accuracies of 85–97% came from evaluation protocols that did not clearly reflect cross-subject generalization.
paperCard.method: The authors compare two preprocessing and feature-extraction pipelines on the same public dataset using the same random forest classifier. Evaluation is strict: 5-fold subject-wise cross-validation (train on some subjects, test on unseen ones), trial-level majority voting over 1-second windows, and a paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test for pipeline comparison.
paperCard.difference: Earlier work often used subject-dependent splits or did not describe the data split in detail, inflating accuracy. This study deliberately uses a strictly subject-independent protocol, so the numbers are much lower but more realistic, and it compares feature representations rather than relying on more complex models.
paperCard.innovation: To the authors' knowledge, this is the first evaluation of the Kumar dataset under these strict constraints, providing a realistic reference point; a forward feature-selection procedure also shows that a limited subset of bands (especially alpha, and alpha plus delta) captures most discriminative information.
paperCard.implementation: Shared preprocessing retains the central 10 seconds per trial, segments into 1-second windows with 75% overlap, and applies subject-wise z-score normalization. The Kumar pipeline uses a 5-point moving average and four per-channel statistics (sd, rms, sum, signal energy), giving 56 features; the spectral pipeline applies a 50 Hz notch and 0.5–60 Hz bandpass filter, estimates power spectral density via periodogram, and integrates absolute band power over delta, theta, alpha, beta and gamma, giving 70 features with log transformation. Classification uses a 200-tree random forest with StratifiedGroupKFold to keep subjects within folds.
paperCard.applications: Assistive brain–computer interfaces for communication (e.g., helping locked-in patients express themselves), design of cross-subject generalizable EEG decoders, and a trustworthy benchmark for future method research; the strict subject-independent evaluation idea also transfers to other physiological-signal studies.
technicalTerms: EEG: electrical brain activity recorded from scalp electrodes, weak and noisy
Imagined speech decoding: inferring the words or categories a person silently imagines from brain activity
Subject-independent evaluation: test participants never appear in training, measuring generalization to new people
Random forest: a classifier of many decision trees voting together, stable but not state of the art
PSD (power spectral density): a curve showing how much signal energy lies at each frequency
Band power: total EEG energy computed separately for delta, theta, alpha, beta and gamma bands
Majority voting: aggregating predictions from several 1-second windows into one trial-level decision
Cross-validation: rotating data through several train/test folds to reduce the luck of a single split
Forward feature selection: starting from one feature and adding the most helpful ones to see if performance improves
Artifact: interference from blinks, muscle activity and other non-brain sources

articles.title: ZeroLu/awesome-seedance-2.5
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 这是一个 GitHub 上的 awesome 类资源仓库，把 Seedance 2.5 视频模型的提示词（prompt）与示例集中整理成清单，目前获得 121 颗星且有近期公开活动。它的价值在于把散落的提示工程经验产品化，让使用者不必从零试错就能上手一个具体的 AI 视频生成工具。对非技术管理者而言，它是观察“模型能力如何被提示词这一层放大或限制”的低成本样本。
articles.failureAnalysis: 这类清单型仓库的护城河极浅：内容本质是使用技巧，很容易被官方文档、模型更新后的内置模板或更活跃的社区仓库替代。Seedance 2.5 属于闭源商业模型，版本一升级，旧提示词的示例与效果就可能失效，维护者需持续投入却几乎没有直接收益，容易停止更新。需求侧也偏窄，主要服务已付费使用该模型的创作者，难以形成独立业务；即便流量不错，变现路径通常也只是导流或赞助，天花板明显。

en.highlight: An awesome list of curated Seedance 2.5 prompts and examples, meant as a go-to resource for mastering prompt engineering and exploring the AI video model's creative potential.
en.summary: This is a GitHub 'awesome' repository that collects Seedance 2.5 prompts and examples into a single curated list, currently with 121 stars and recent public activity. Its value is packaging scattered prompt-engineering know-how so users can get productive with one specific AI video model without starting from scratch. For a non-technical manager, it is a cheap way to see how much the prompt layer amplifies or limits a model's real capability.
en.failureAnalysis: Curated prompt lists have almost no moat: the content is usage know-how that official docs, built-in templates, or a livelier community repo can easily replace. Seedance 2.5 is a closed commercial model, so a version upgrade can invalidate old prompts, while maintainers get little direct return for continuous upkeep.
en.title: Seedance 2.5 Prompt Collection: A 121-Star Resource for AI Video Prompt Engineering
